title: Echo Faces North
hints: Echo starts facing a different way, so "forward" sends it somewhere else.
Plan for LoopBot. Then check that Echo ends on its lift too.

story.intro: PATCH: "Careful. Echo is facing a different way. Forward means forward for each of them, wherever they face."
story.outro: PATCH: "Same program, different start, different path. Keep that in mind up here."
